lines_of_business: Community Plan and Medicare Advantage have separate policies (listed on cover)
effective_or_revised: Policy 2026T0557FF; effective July 1, 2026 (history entry 07/17/2026 code update)
sections_in_order: Coverage Rationale (Aortic; Mitral; Pulmonary; Tricuspid; Other Devices and Procedures)
Medical Records Documentation Used for Reviews
criteria_location: Coverage Rationale, pp.1-3 of 40. Aortic criteria are an ALL list of 5 items on p.1 with a valve-in-valve paragraph and a low-flow/low-gradient note on p.2. Center requirements are partly inline (3 bullets) and partly in Definitions ('CMS Volume Requirements', p.3). Roughly 24 pages are clinical evidence and ~9 pages are references.
procedures_covered: Transcatheter aortic valve replacement (native and valve-in-valve)
Mitral edge-to-edge repair (primary and secondary MR); mitral replacement/annuloplasty unproven
Tricuspid edge-to-edge repair; tricuspid replacement unproven
Cerebral protection devices and caval valves (unproven)

logic.top_level: pathways (per valve; native aortic ALL list; valve-in-valve; case-by-case note for LFLG)

k_of_n.quote: Diagnosis of severe calcific native aortic valve stenosis, as indicated by one of the following: Mean aortic valve gradient of >= 40 mm Hg; or Peak aortic jet velocity of >= 4.0 m/s; or Aortic valve area of <= 1.0 cm2

logic.exclusions_or_contraindications: Not a separate list; 'when performed according to FDA-labeled indications, contraindications, warnings, and precautions' imports the label. Unproven items list for other devices.
logic.initial_vs_repeat: Valve-in-valve addressed as its own paragraph; mitral valve-in-valve 'case-by-case'.

and_or_ambiguity.quote: Procedure is performed in a center that meets all the following criteria: On-site heart valve surgery and interventional cardiology programs; and Postprocedure intensive care unit ...; and Volume requirements consistent with the Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: 'and' chain crosses a page break; volume requirements resolved only via Definitions and external NCD/TVT registry.

and_or_ambiguity.quote: Requests for transcatheter aortic heart valve replacement for low-flow/low-gradient aortic stenosis in individuals who do not meet the peak velocity, mean gradient, and valve area criteria listed above will be considered on a case-by-case basis
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: A discretionary escape hatch around the numeric criteria; 'peak velocity, mean gradient, and valve area criteria' implies all, while the criteria are one-of.

and_or_ambiguity.quote: Individual is symptomatic [NYHA class II or greater] and symptoms are due to aortic valve stenosis
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: Causal attribution requirement within a single leaf.

codes.codes_tied_to_criteria: One flat CPT table (0345T-0806T, 33361-33370, 33418-33419, 33477 ...) without mapping to the valve sections.
codes.non_covered_code_lists: Header says language may indicate non-covered; none marked by code.

external_dependencies.quote: Some benefit documents allow coverage of experimental/investigational/unproven treatments for life-threatening illnesses when certain conditions are met.

definitions_that_change_meaning.term: CMS Volume Requirements for Transcatheter Aortic Heart Valve Replacement
definitions_that_change_meaning.definition_quote: ≥ 50 open heart surgeries in the previous year prior to TAVR program initiation; and ≥ 20 aortic valve-related procedures in the 2 years prior ...
a process by which physicians and individuals work together to choose the treatment option that best reflects the clinical evidence and the individual's values and preferences
The Society of Thoracic Surgeons Predicted Risk of Mortality score is a predictor of 30-day mortality after cardiac procedures

extraction_hazards: Header footers show inconsistent 'Page 1 of 2', 'Page 2 of 3', ... 'Page 39 of 40' (page counter changes while document grows)
Multi-valve document: aortic, mitral, pulmonary, tricuspid share 'symptomatic', 'NYHA' and 'PROM' tokens, so keyword search crosses valves
Bullet glyphs are lost: nested o items rely on indentation
About 21 pages (pp.7-28) of clinical evidence include Siontis, PARTNER numbers that look like thresholds
Cover table of contents lists 'Medical Records Documentation Used for Reviews' but no content follows
interesting_structures: Facility attributes (center with ICU, volume per CMS) as eligibility criteria sitting beside patient criteria
Definitions block reproduces the CMS NCD volume requirements in detail, effectively embedding a second policy
Shared decision-making as a required conversation (patient-process criterion)
Case-by-case exception path for low-flow/low-gradient AS
Policy history lists the exact edit-by-edit changes (useful for versioning)

fit_to_tree.why: Native aortic criteria are a clean ALL with one 1-of-3; facility, SDM and the case-by-case exception are not chart-checkable; multi-valve layout needs section scoping.
